verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch supports login-optional usage, self-hosting, and a PWA/desktop app that can run without a cloud account (hoppscotch-comm-9, hoppscotch-gh-7, hoppscotch-docs-14), but hands-on community feedback shows real limits to full offline workspace usage: only one workspace is available offline, workspace data can't be pointed to a local directory, and self-host login isn't possible in the desktop app (hoppscotch-comm-10). Missing for 10: first-party docs describing a dedicated fully-offline local workspace mode, and resolution of the community-reported offline workspace limitations.
